intelligence.human_view: The manual is the engineering record for NayaPOWER and NayaNET with collective team technology: how to file a note so it lands on the feed and in the Box, how to lock a Supabase table, how to deploy the Hub and prove it live from the URL, what the next missing app is (Smart Notes, the first chart row with no View app link), and what the seed, the tree, the forest, and the living garden mean. The fresh-agent test also found the gaps honestly: the note template is never shown, the lock has no SQL in the manual, the Hub deploy names no worker target, and the six-table re-prove needs a sanctioned path to the anon key. Those are the next fixes, not hidden — they are in the report.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a big instruction book for building a whole city — what the city is, how the water and the roads and the lights work, what is already built, what is still missing, and how to use every tool. A stranger picked it up, read it alone, answered five questions about the city, and checked the real city to see it was true. That is the manual.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like the family cookbook, but for a whole world: everything written down so anyone in the family can make the meal, fix the house, and keep the garden growing — and a new cousin proved it by cooking one dish from the book alone, without asking anyone.
intelligence.naya_view: The manual is the picture made whole — the concept, the logic, the worlds, the inventory, what remains, and the machine that builds the machine. A sister who reads it understands completely, and that is the point: the team operates from understanding, not from barked orders. The MD is the working paper; this note, live on the feed and in the Box, is the value.
